allies.rationale_text: Step-back helps baseline-establishment pause execution long enough to define the starting picture, output, and success frame first.
allies.source_quote: The process requires synthesizing initial facts, hypotheses, and assumptions into an organized structure before commencing problem-solving or action.
allies.affinity_rationale: Enabling mechanism — 'requires synthesizing initial facts, hypotheses, and assumptions into an organized structure' — the deliberate pause that allows principled baseline definition instead of rushing to execution.
allies.activation_condition: When the team is about to begin analysis or execution without having explicitly defined the starting conditions against which progress will be measured

allies.rationale_text: Auditability-traceability gives baseline-establishment a durable record of what the starting condition actually was, so later change claims can be checked.
allies.source_quote: Successful outcomes are predicated on defining a clear, accurate starting point ... against which all future actions, deviations, and results are measured.
allies.affinity_rationale: Recording complement — 'Successful outcomes are predicated on defining a clear, accurate starting point against which all subsequent analysis and measurement can be compared' — preserves the baseline as a durable reference.
allies.activation_condition: When the baseline needs to be preserved as a traceable reference point for future comparison rather than being lost or distorted as the project evolves

antagonists.rationale_text: Anchoring undermines baseline-establishment by letting the first data point or frame encountered become the de facto baseline, preventing the team from defining a genuinely representative starting condition.
antagonists.source_quote: In decision-making, the Baseline acts as an anchor—the outside view that disciplines the inevitable biases of the inside view. Establishing this anchor first ensures that individual perspectives are married with what is true of the world in general.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Directly corrupts the model's core function — 'the Baseline acts as an anchor' — when the first data point encountered becomes the baseline without independent verification, the entire subsequent analysis is built on a biased foundation.
antagonists.activation_condition: When the first data point or frame encountered is being treated as the baseline without independent verification that it represents the actual starting conditions

structured_tensions.tension_text: Baseline-establishment conflicts with representativeness-heuristic when salient recent data points are mistaken for a robust baseline.
structured_tensions.source_quote: baseline-establishment vs representativeness-heuristic: baseline-establishment conflicts with representativeness-heuristic (representativeness bias) when salient recent points are mistaken for robust baseline.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Baseline-establishment conflicts with status-quo-bias when obsolete baselines remain unchallenged after the context has shifted.
structured_tensions.source_quote: baseline-establishment vs status-quo-bias: baseline-establishment conflicts with status-quo-bias (status quo bias) when obsolete baselines remain unchallenged after context shift.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Baseline-establishment conflicts with confirmation-bias when evidence is filtered to preserve the existing baseline instead of honestly challenging whether it still reflects reality.
structured_tensions.source_quote: baseline-establishment vs confirmation-bias: baseline-establishment conflicts with confirmation-bias (confirmation bias) when evidence is filtered to confirm the existing baseline rather than honestly challenge whether it still reflects reality.
